document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
When you are next yourself, years have passed. An inmate in 
a Winnipeg asylum, you have lived there since being found by 
a missionary, living with a remote community of people as a 
sacred Mad One.

With the recovery of your memory, you rapidly recuperate. 
You  return  to  Arkham  and  try  to  pick  up  the  threads  of 
your life. As you were long presumed dead, your position at 
Miskatonic University has been filled. Your estate has been 
apportioned  among  your  heirs;  only  litigation  restores  a 
portion of what was yours.

With time, the night fears diminish, but you can secure only 
second-rate teaching jobs and your lectures become notorious 
for  occasional  interruptions  where  you  tail  off,  staring  into 
space. You publish your account of the North Hanninah trip 
but,  without  documentation  or  physical  evidence,  and  with 
your history of insanity, you convince no one except an eccentric 
occult fringe group.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
